content:
maya: spotting a small class of reports: console shows v2 badge but traces + billing show execution on v1. seems related to weird X-Client-Version encodings (e.g. quoted-string vs bare).
tom: any sample ids?
maya: req 04JXQ9Z7AA33. headers logged as X-Client-Version: "v2" (including quotes). console badge logic treats that as v2, routing parser strips quotes and ends up treating as absent -> fallback to v1.
zhen: ah. parser inconsistency between console ingestion and routing. console does a loose string match, routing normalizes header first. explains the mismatch.
claire: immediate risk: customers think they used v2 capacity and see badge + simple quota preview showing v2 usage. billing currently uses routed_version but badge + quick UI reads requested_version. that's confusing.
eng-bot: [metric] version_attribution_mismatch count +0.04 for tenant-cohort alpha in last 15m.
tom: mitigation idea: console should prefer routed_version when available. small UI read change and a tooltip that explains fallback. low-risk and fast.
zhen: agree. I'll also add a small header-normalization telemetry event (raw_header vs normalized_version) sampled at 0.1% so we can measure prevalence.
maya: operational quickfix: add a dashboard alert when tenant mismatch ratio > 5% and a temporary banner on tenant pages: "Badge shows requested version; executed version available in request details."
claire: longer term: harden header parsing to canonicalize quoted vs bare in ingress and emit both requested_version and routed_version in logs. plus consider delaying quota attribution commit until after routing decision or emit compensating decrement on fallback.
eng-bot: [deploy] routing canary updated to emit routed_version tag at 1888881305.
zhen: I'll open PRs: console read change (w/ tooltip) and telemetry sampling. ETA console hotfix 3h, telemetry 1h.
maya: sounds good. I'll notify CS + billing team and update the runbook. thanks all. :thumbsup:
__notes: Slack thread formatted as a single string with messages prefixed by sender. No title field per agents.md. All metadata fields are strings or list of strings.
